items.reasoning: ML inside AI, DL inside ML; genAI and agentic AI are newer branches built on that stack — B inverts DL/ML containment, D's supersession claim is false.
Algorithm = learning procedure, model = trained artifact, nightly scoring = inference; A/C confuse inferencing with training, D merges two different kinds of thing.
Labeled continuous target = supervised regression; C throws away the required exact-price output, A discards the labels, B has no environment to learn from.
Nightly complete manifest + morning-only consumption + minimal ops = managed batch inference; real-time endpoint and self-hosting fight the workload shape.
Sensor feed = structured time-series, free-text notes = unstructured text; modality and structure are orthogonal properties, CSV is just the container.

Deterministic published-table logic (zero tolerance for prediction error) + negative cost-benefit are the canonical when-NOT-to-use-ML findings; A is a false legal claim, C anecdote, E rentable compute.
Predicting a future quantity from historical time-ordered data = forecasting; A trades on the word 'false', C flattens the needed quantity into two buckets.

items.chosen: s1=Amazon Transcribe; s2=Amazon Polly; s3=Amazon Comprehend; s4=Amazon Translate; s5=Amazon Transcribe
items.keyed: s1=Amazon Transcribe; s2=Amazon Polly; s3=Amazon Comprehend; s4=Amazon Translate; s5=Amazon Transcribe
items.reasoning: Speech-to-text = Transcribe (s1, s5), text-to-speech = Polly, NLP sentiment/key-phrases = Comprehend, language translation = Translate.
No network + in-flight results + regulator explainability all force a compact traditional on-device model; every FM option violates a stated constraint.
EDA, pre-processing, feature engineering, train/tune, evaluate, deploy, monitor — the only ordering that is both sensible and ends with monitoring.
Two engineers, six weeks, 1,200 labels = adapt an open-source pre-trained model; from-scratch needs orders of magnitude more, delay burns the grant.
The gap is a missing discipline (repeatability, versioning, bus-factor), not a missing tool license or a shadowing hire.
Unchanged artifact + shifted economy = data drift; durable response is monitoring feeding retraining; weights do not decay with use.
2% base rate + 40x asymmetric miss cost = recall on the fraud class; the board's payoff question = ROI as the business metric.
Context windows and billing are token-denominated; ~9,000 English words is more than 9,000 tokens; the 1:1 and per-character claims are false.
Chunk, embed, nearest-neighbor: conceptual similarity becomes geometric distance; C describes a topic taxonomy, not embedding retrieval.
Rewriting instructions and worked examples is prompt engineering — input-side only, zero weight change, zero training cost; D mislabels it context engineering.

items.chosen: s1=Transformer-based large language model; s2=Diffusion model; s3=Multi-modal model; s4=Transformer-based large language model; s5=Diffusion model
items.keyed: s1=Transformer-based large language model; s2=Diffusion model; s3=Multi-modal model; s4=Transformer-based large language model; s5=Diffusion model
items.reasoning: Text-to-text = LLM (s1, s4); image generation and image variation = diffusion (s2, s5); mixed photo+text input = multi-modal (s3); s5 is the one cell where a multi-modal reading is arguable — image-to-image variation is diffusion's home turf.
Open-ended conversation + personalized summarization is where generation earns its place; exact-fidelity OCR is anti-generative, churn is classic ML.
Full FM lifecycle ends with feedback into the next iteration; B truncates at ship, C runs pre-training after fine-tuning, A deletes evaluation.
6,000-in/400-out means input tokens drive cost (trim the prompt); a predictable dinner peak hitting on-demand limits is the provisioned-throughput case.
The instructions are already good; what enters the call and how pieces are prioritized is failing — context engineering, not wording (D) or weights (C).
Acting on external systems = tool usage; multi-day persistent state = memory management; window size, weights, and timeouts do not confer agency.
System patterns = division of work among specialized agents; communication patterns = coordination and handoff; B confuses with load-balanced scaling.
MCP is the open protocol connecting agents/assistants to external tools and data through a standard interface — not transport encryption, prompting, or a Bedrock scheduler.
Confident fluent invented citations = hallucination, an inherent failure mode needing designed-in controls — not a rare patchable bug or corrupt artifact.
FM output is nondeterministic by nature; durable fix is run-once-share-result; temperature 0 (A) reduces variability but promises no guarantee.
Latency, residency, and cost cap are binding constraints — filter first, then take the most capable survivor; a leaderboard rank cannot compensate.
Multi-provider FM catalog + grounding + safeguards with no infrastructure = Amazon Bedrock; SageMaker is the build-your-own layer below.
Managed service = lower barrier/faster to market + inherited security-compliance-safety; B's hallucination-elimination is false, D describes self-hosting.
A 40k-token input several candidates cannot accept is a hard eliminator — filter on input/output length first, then weigh languages, latency, cost.
An identical 3,500-token preamble on 12,000 requests/day is prompt caching's exact profile, cutting cost and latency; provisioned throughput (D) fixes a different problem.
Temperature 1.0 left over from a creativity experiment = widened sampling randomness; turn it back down; erratic output is not a knowledge gap.
Knowledge newer than training data + unaffordable retraining = RAG by design; quarterly fine-tuning is the treadmill, full-library prompts flood the window.
PostgreSQL-fluent team = RDS for PostgreSQL with vector search, a named AWS vector-store option; the embedding model does not dictate the store.
Cheapest-first: in-context learning, RAG, fine-tuning, pre-training — with distillation a separate compression route; D swaps the first two rungs.
An agent's delta over a chatbot is completing multi-step tasks by orchestrating tool/API calls; A is RAG grounding, C confuses autonomy with zero oversight, D confuses agent with bigger model.
A working prompt = context + clear instruction + negative prompts naming the banned phrasings, refined by experimentation; repetition and recency tricks are folklore.

items.chosen: s1=Zero-shot prompting; s2=Few-shot prompting; s3=Chain-of-thought prompting; s4=Prompt template; s5=Zero-shot prompting
items.keyed: s1=Zero-shot prompting; s2=Few-shot prompting; s3=Chain-of-thought prompting; s4=Prompt template; s5=Zero-shot prompting
items.reasoning: No examples = zero-shot (s1, s5); worked examples = few-shot; step-by-step shown reasoning = CoT; stored placeholder prompt = template.
Attacker corrupts the ingested retrieval corpus = poisoning; hijacking would repurpose the assistant's task — here the corruption lives in the content.
Untracked console prompt edits with no attribution or rollback = prompt versioning (Bedrock Prompt Management), prompts managed like code.
Large unlabeled domain corpus + cross-task terminology command = continuous pre-training; fine-tuning needs labels, distillation is the later kiosk step.
Instruction-response pairs across tasks = instruction tuning; actuarial-language specialization = domain adaptation; health-claims model reused for disability = transfer learning.
Fine-tuning data must be labeled (signal) and representative of production traffic; maximum-volume and raw-authenticity are anti-patterns, 30-day recency is a schedule not a property.
Pairwise human preference rankings with no gold labels = RLHF's native input; D's best-of-n filter never changes the model, A presupposes labels that do not exist.
Subjective quality at scale = human-in-the-loop sets the standard, LLM-as-a-judge calibrated to it carries the weekly volume; benchmarks measure the wrong question.
ROUGE is the summarization overlap metric and certifies nothing about factual correctness; BLEU is translation's metric; C's similarity-implies-faithfulness is false.
Strong component scores + wrong end-to-end answers = evaluate the application as a pipeline on real questions; the failure lives where components meet.
Business value = task completion rate + cost per interaction vs the human baseline; ROUGE and leaderboards are model metrics, the annual survey cannot attribute.
Fairness/inclusivity is built in the data: diverse curated sources spanning served populations + balanced datasets; volume and single-market uniformity are anti-answers.
Denied topics + profanity/PII filtering on both prompts and responses is Bedrock Guardrails' feature set at the boundary; a system-prompt instruction is a request, not enforcement.
Both models meet the accuracy target, so the energy difference is a legitimate selection criterion tipping to mid-size; offsets compensate instead of avoiding.
Generative-specific register entries: IP infringement claims from generated output + biased outputs harming players; D swaps in generic ops risks, B is concealment.
99% train vs 71% validation = overfitting (memorized specifics); underfitting would depress both scores; validation images rule out the camera-noise story.
Bias discovery = subgroup accuracy analysis + label-quality review of historical decisions + human audits (A2I); the aggregate is the number that conceals it.
Transparency accounts for the system, explainability for the individual decision — different properties, different artifacts; documentation alone answers only the first request.
Explainability that reaches people = SageMaker Model Cards (purpose, limitations) + Clarify (bias findings, feature attributions); KMS + CloudTrail is the adjacent security job.
A regulated high-stakes decision that must be defensible can force the interpretable 91% model over the opaque 94%; post-hoc explainers produce stories, not the factors.
First control = least-privilege IAM roles/policies/permissions per team across data, models, endpoints; CloudTrail is detective, prompt rules are not access control.
In place and in motion = KMS encryption at rest and in transit; off the public internet = PrivateLink; the others are paperwork or blast-radius expansion.
Sensitive data scattered in text: discover with Macie, then privacy-enhancing technologies + access control BEFORE training; Inspector scans workloads, not content.
Responsibility shifts with how much of the GenAI stack you own — the Generative AI Security Scoping Matrix maps exactly that; the SaaS-era checklist no longer fits.
A never-emit requirement is enforced on the output side — filter and validate what leaves the model before display; input screening misses model-originated harms.
Instruction-bearing third-party document obeyed = prompt injection; the counter sits at the input boundary, treating untrusted content as data, not command.
Know where answers came from = source citation + data lineage via cataloging; prove what was said = audit trail with interaction logging — traceability in both directions.
API-call history with caller identity and timing = CloudTrail event history; CloudWatch gives counts not callers, Config tracks configuration state.
Retention, residency, monitoring, and training all lapsed = governance operated as a document, not a lifecycle; rewriting the binder repeats the failure.
